from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,os,ast,re,stat,collections
base=Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads')
vault=Path('/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads')
print('AUDIT_BEGIN')
print('INSTALLED_SHA',(base/'.verified-source-commit').read_text().strip())
print('WORKTREE_PRESENT',(base/'.rea-fix-status-20261030').exists())
print('BACKUP_PRESENT',(base/'.rea-tests-backup-655a9115-20261030').exists())
for f in [vault/'group_allowlist.txt',vault/'approved_users.txt',vault/'growth_model.json',Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads/operation-state.json'),Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads/public-groups.json')]:
 print('CONFIG_FILE',f.name,'present',f.is_file(),'bytes',f.stat().st_size if f.is_file() else '-', 'mode',oct(stat.S_IMODE(f.stat().st_mode)) if f.is_file() else '-')
env=vault/'.env'
vals={}
for line in env.read_text().splitlines():
 match=re.match(r'^\s*(?:export\s+)?([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*(.*)$',line)
 if match: vals[match.group(1)]=match.group(2)
for key in ['TELEGRAM_API_ID','TELEGRAM_API_HASH','TARGET_GROUP','TELEGRAM_PUBLIC_DISCOVERY_ENABLED','TELEGRAM_GROUP_ALLOWLIST','TELEGRAM_APPROVED_USERS','TELEGRAM_OPERATION_STATE','TELEGRAM_TZ','TELEGRAM_REGION_SPLIT','TELEGRAM_FIXED_SCRAPE_GROUPS']:
 print('ENV_FLAG',key,'present',key in vals,'nonempty',bool(vals.get(key)))
for name in ['scripts/telethon_sessions.py','scripts/organic_growth.py','scripts/activate_project_only.py','scripts/growth_radar.py','scripts/telegram-robot-leads-status.sh','scripts/telegram-iptvpn-status.sh']:
 q=base/name; t=q.read_text()
 print('MODULE',name,'lines',len(t.splitlines()))
 if name.endswith('.py'):
  tree=ast.parse(t)
  print('SYMBOLS',','.join(x.name for x in tree.body if isinstance(x,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef,ast.ClassDef))))
for name in ['scripts/telethon_sessions.py','scripts/lead_health.py']:
 q=base/name;lines=q.read_text().splitlines()
 for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
  if 'if __name__' in line or 'parse_args' in line or 'add_argument(' in line or 'def online' in line or 'def inspect' in line:
   print('CLI',name,i,line.strip()[:130])
py=str(base/'.venv/bin/python')
sha=(base/'.verified-source-commit').read_text().strip()
commands=[
 ('operational',[py,str(base/'scripts/leads_operational_report.py'),'--checkout',str(base),'--expected-source',sha,'--vault',str(vault),'--with-pm2']),
 ('health',[py,str(base/'scripts/lead_health.py'),'--root',str(vault),'--with-pm2'])]
for name,cmd in commands:
 z=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
 print('DIAGNOSTIC',name,'exit',z.returncode)
 if z.returncode: print('DIAGNOSTIC_ERROR',type(z.stderr).__name__,z.stderr[-250:]);continue
 d=json.loads(z.stdout)
 if name=='operational':
  for k in ('status','readiness_indicators','members_added','messages_sent','telegram_requests','operation_state','public_discovery','action_queue','pm2','supervisor'):
   v=d.get(k);print('DIAG_FIELD',k,json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=True)[:1350])
  v=d.get('sessions',{})
  print('DIAG_SESSION',json.dumps({k:v.get(k) for k in ('accounts','api_source','online_verified','own_application_api_configured','status')}))
 else:
  print('DIAG_HEALTH',json.dumps({k:d.get(k) for k in ('runtime','accounts','legacy_runtime','legacy_config_keys_present','credentials')},ensure_ascii=True)[:1100])
for old in sorted(Path('/opt').glob('.telegram-leads-previous-*')):
 print('ARCHIVE',old.name,'exists',old.is_dir(),'owner',old.stat().st_uid)
print('AUDIT_END')
PY
